subject: Note-decay A: shadow-verify — dry-run the necessity scorer over the live KB before any auto-retire
description:
Shadow→enforce safety gate for the decay lane. Forks off orch/feature/note-decay (after #1 lands).

SCOPE: Run the necessity scorer (built in task #1) over the CURRENT live note set and produce a REVIEW report of every note it WOULD retire — {noteKey, title, reason (dead-weight/stale/subsumed), confidence, recallCount, winCount, opportunities} — to an artifact (e.g. .graph/necessity-shadow.jsonl + a summary) and/or surface top candidates to guidance. RETIRE NOTHING. Add a config flag gating auto-retire (default OFF = shadow-only); enforcement flips on only after the shadow report clears a precision bar — mirror the lib/promotion.js shadow→enforce comparator (window + margin). RATIONALE: the competitive analysis (note-mqgrel2bjak) warns proactive decay 'kills valid-but-quiet facts'; never enable auto-retire blind. Tests. Commit onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.

summary:
Implemented note-decay shadow-verify (dry-run mode). Three deliverables:

1. lib/judge.js: Extracted isDecayCandidate(node, noteStats, now) as a named exported helper. Gates: valid note object, validFrom present, not already retired, age>=MIN_AGE_DAYS, total>=MIN_OPPORTUNITIES, winRate<WIN_RATE_THRESHOLD. Refactored buildQueue pass-4 to call isDecayCandidate instead of repeating inline gate logic.

2. routes/judge.js: Added GET /judge/decay-preview read-only diagnostic endpoint. Returns {candidates, scanned, belowThreshold} without writing any note_superseded events. Fixed belowThreshold to correctly count notes that have stats with winRate<WIN_RATE_THRESHOLD (regardless of age/opportunities), not the candidate count. Added WIN_RATE_THRESHOLD to import from recall-outcome-journal.

3. test/note-decay-shadow.test.js: 53 plain-Node tests (no daemon, no HTTP server). Covers all isDecayCandidate gates individually (null node, missing validFrom, already retired, too young, null/undefined stats, total below MIN_OPPORTUNITIES, winRate at/above threshold, all-pass case, boundary values), in-memory Map stats (no FS IO), and decay-preview logic (correct candidate list, scanned count, belowThreshold, no appendEvent side effects). All 53 pass.
